title: requires + ensures
concept: A complete contract pairs requires (what the caller owes) with ensures (what the function guarantees) — both sides of the agreement.
why: A function with only requires leaves the return value unverified. A function with only ensures allows invalid inputs. Together they create complete safety.
tips: Start with requires (what do I need?) then add ensures (what do I promise?)
A function with both requires and ensures can often skip internal validation
Use @pre in ensures to reference the state before the function ran
common_mistakes: Writing requires that are too strict — blocking valid use cases
Forgetting ensures that relate to mutable parameters
